original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Bounded exact containment reuse in the complete PR6396 independent member-to-occupied-bank census.
scope_change_reason: Choose one fresh concrete caller for replay-runtime. Predecessor mathematics is a cited premise; the contribution is an opt-in equivalent implementation and its measured complete-command cost.
bottleneck_link: This lowers the cost of exact source-bound BIT research evidence. It does not supply a changed helper word, new productive entitlement or supplier admission.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified speed improvement and package it without extending the optimization.
evidence: PROOF.md, replay.py and verify.py establish adapter equivalence; BENCHMARK.json binds five alternating complete-command pairs.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Should the same bounded containment reuse be adopted in a future version of the original census?
open_questions.why_it_matters: An isolated adapter does not change the source default or establish equivalence after its geometry or predicate contract changes.
open_questions.first_step: Bind a specific new source head and its immutable space and pure-predicate contract, then preserve its complete receipt and failure controls.
open_questions.blocked_by: Source adoption and any changed caller contract remain outside this isolated package.
